parsedVerdict.reasoning: The src/domain module covers one concern: the task-management domain model. Each entity is paired with its repository port. Project.ts, User.ts and Task.ts declare the entities. ProjectRepository.ts, UserRepository.ts and TaskRepository.ts declare persistence interfaces that use only those entity types. All three repositories follow the same style: save, getById returning null when nothing is found, and either getAll or project-scoped queries. The only domain rule, canMarkDone, is defined once in Task.ts. The TaskStatus union is also defined once there and reused by TaskRepository.ts, so neither is duplicated. No file goes around the module's own abstractions. Task.withStatus and Task.withAssignee both rebuild the whole Task, which is minor internal repetition but does not duplicate a rule or invariant.
